summary: The content on the Andi homepage has been updated with new examples of search queries and a slight reorganization of the 'Getting Started' section.

change_summary.what_changed: The content on the Andi homepage has been updated with new examples of search queries and a slight reorganization of the 'Getting Started' section.
specific_changes: New search query examples have been added, such as 'steve jobs pixar story', 'Who is Joan of Arc?', and 'give me a tutorial on how to make the perfect resume'.

The 'Getting Started' section has been slightly reorganized with new text and examples, including 'See what Elon's tweeting. Try 'go twitter elonmusk'' and 'Go direct to website content. Try 'go youtube cute pandas''.
Some minor changes in wording and formatting have been made throughout the page.

strategic_analysis.business_impact: The updates reflect Andi's continuous effort to improve user experience and provide more relevant examples for users to engage with the AI search agent. This could potentially increase user retention and attract new users interested in AI-powered search solutions.
strategic_analysis.competitive_implications: Andi is positioning itself as a unique search agent with AI capabilities, privacy, and no ads, which could attract users dissatisfied with traditional search engines.
strategic_analysis.strategic_direction: Andi seems to be focusing on enhancing its core search functionality and user interface, indicating a strategy to compete in the search engine market with a privacy-focused, AI-driven approach.
